title: Codex almost deleted my whole game.
author: VR38DET
selftext: I’ve been vibe coding a game recently and I had just sent a prompt to codex. A few minutes in I realised I prompted the wrong thing and clicked the stop button. Now usually this makes the windows app freeze as it does everytime it finishes a task, but this time it glitched and the game file was 0 bytes after. Game was basically gone. Luckily I had the latest version of the game still loaded in the codex browser and codex managed to scrape the game back together after an hour of working. It managed to get it back close enough  to the latest version but I still had to edit some things. always keep your project open in codex browser!!!!

replies.author: adunato

replies.author: adunato
replies.body: We all learn about git the hard way. Luckily for you, you don't even have to learn git commands and can just ask the LLM agent to take care of commits and push. Just remember that git works locally so in order to be "backed up" you have to set up an account on github and push your local repo to the cloud.
